examples.title: Example 1: Implementing Waterfall Layout Using a Custom Layout Algorithm
examples.description:
This example shows how to override the onMeasure and onLayout functions to display the product list in waterfall layout.
Since API version 24, onMeasure and onLayout are added.

examples.title: Example 2: Switching the Layout Algorithm
examples.description:
This example demonstrates how to dynamically switch the layout algorithm of the DynamicLayout component by changing the LayoutAlgorithm variable decorated by @Local. Specifically, it shows how to switch between RowLayoutAlgorithm, ColumnLayoutAlgorithm, StackLayoutAlgorithm and GridLayoutAlgorithm.
Since API version 24, RowLayoutAlgorithm, ColumnLayoutAlgorithm, StackLayoutAlgorithm, and GridLayoutAlgorithm have been added.

examples.title: Example 3: Modifying the Layout Algorithm Attributes
examples.description:
This example shows how to modify the space and justifyContent attributes of RowLayoutAlgorithm to update the layout effect of the DynamicLayout component.
Since API version 24, the space and justifyContent attributes are added.
